when.en: A delivered surface has findings at two owners: small ones repaired in place, one repaired at its library owner and consumed, then served, measured and walked again.
when.vi: Một bề mặt đã giao có phát hiện ở hai chủ sở hữu: cái nhỏ sửa tại chỗ, một cái sửa ở owner thư viện rồi tiêu thụ, sau đó phục vụ, đo lại và đi thử lại.

mission.goal: a delivered surface's findings are closed at their owners, then the surface is served, measured and walked again

doneWhen.evidence: the heading finding is fixed on the session branch
the muted-contrast finding is fixed on the session branch
the owner release carrying the hit-area repair is consumed at an exact version
the served surface passes the audit with the closed findings measured
the checkout's gates are green at the served head
a person's journey completes on the served surface

note: The two interface.fix lines are two branches of one operator without a plan (a fix has one finding); the generator outputs the fixes bind are imported from the session that delivered the surface, so no interface.generate branch is drawn. Written for the Setup rerun on 2.0.3.
